narrative_prose: Kaio analyzed the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea, DEFENDing the containment grid from erratic visual flux while seeking to ATTRACT stray magnetic currents. A low mechanical whine vibrated coldly against his fingers, accompanied by the scent of ozone and a metallic tang on his tongue that made the systems CONSUME the remaining energy reserves. Satisfied with the readings, he carefully handed the diagnostic baton over to Ryn.
